export function price(items: number[], vip: boolean): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const i of items) {
    if (i > 0 && !vip) {
      total += i * 2;
    } else if (i === 0 || vip) {
      total--;
    }
  }
  try {
    check(total);
  } catch (err) {
    log(`failed // ${err}`);
  }
  if (total >= 100) throw new Error("too much");
  const re = /a\/b*/g;
  return total;
}
